topics.name: LLM agents and tool use
topics.summary: Across tool-using agents, search and planning tasks, the clusters emphasize multi-step orchestration, memory of intermediate state, and verification of actions in open-ended environments.

topics.name: Retrieval-augmented generation and long-term memory
topics.summary: These papers pair retrieval or structured memory with language-model workflows, showing that evidence selection, provenance checks, and persistent context shape grounded answers and long-horizon behavior.

topics.name: AI safety, alignment, and model behavior
topics.summary: Safety studies examine alignment drift, evaluation bias, and behavioral consistency using controlled prompts, red-team tests, and human or automated judgments across model variants.

topics.name: Vision-language models and multimodal understanding
topics.summary: Multimodal studies combine image, text, and sensor representations for recognition and reasoning, with experiments highlighting transfer limits and the value of explicit visual grounding.

topics.name: Image and video generation with diffusion models
topics.summary: Generative work uses diffusion or distributional matching for video and image synthesis, retrieval, and controllable editing, reporting gains in semantic fidelity and sampling efficiency.

topics.name: Image restoration, editing, and enhancement
topics.summary: Image restoration methods blend physical degradation models, learned priors, and guided refinement to recover detail in low-light, noisy, or compressed observations.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and neural rendering
topics.summary: Neural rendering papers use Gaussian primitives, pixel-aligned features, and view-conditioned synthesis to improve compact 3D reconstruction while retaining fine spatial detail.

topics.name: Computer vision detection and segmentation
topics.summary: Detection and segmentation studies address affect, anatomy, remote sensing, and manipulation scenes with lightweight backbones, multimodal cues, or geometry-aware post-processing.

topics.name: Robotics, manipulation, and embodied learning
topics.summary: Embodied-learning work models contact, trajectories, and future observations for manipulation, multi-robot coordination, and robust behavior under changing physical conditions.

topics.name: Planning, navigation, and autonomous driving
topics.summary: Navigation research combines learned perception with sampling, reinforcement learning, and geometric constraints for autonomous driving, aerial flight, and marine motion planning.

topics.name: Speech, audio, and music generation
topics.summary: Audio studies cover speech emotion and identity, soundscape generation, music interaction, and speech restoration, using self-supervision or diffusion to improve controllability and perceptual quality.

topics.name: Graph learning and relational representation
topics.summary: Graph-based methods encode higher-order relations and temporal structure for epidemiology and structured prediction, evaluating how topology improves risk estimation and generalization.

topics.name: Efficient LLM inference and model compression
topics.summary: Efficiency work reduces cost through token selection, cache management, quantization, and specialized routing, measuring latency, memory traffic, and quality retention in multimodal systems.

topics.name: LLM training, adaptation, and optimization
topics.summary: Optimization studies analyze training dynamics, self-distillation, continual adaptation, and foundation-model transfer, linking algorithmic changes to stability, scaling, and downstream accuracy.

topics.name: Federated, private, and distributed learning
topics.summary: Distributed-learning papers combine federated optimization with privacy defenses and sparse communication, testing personalization and information leakage on mobile or multimodal workloads.

topics.name: Medical imaging and clinical machine learning
topics.summary: Clinical AI studies use imaging, ECG, and language models for diagnosis or reporting, pairing anatomical grounding and retrieval with robustness checks against hallucination and domain shift.

topics.name: Time-series forecasting and dynamical systems
topics.summary: Forecasting work treats logs, markets, sensors, and dynamical processes with probabilistic, neural, and graph models, emphasizing sparse events, uncertainty, and changing regimes.

topics.name: Scientific machine learning and physical simulation
topics.summary: Scientific-learning papers combine neural operators, physics constraints, and generative representations for inverse problems, molecular structure, and multiphysics simulation with less labeled data.

topics.name: Recommender systems and preference modeling
topics.summary: Recommendation studies model user preferences and context with graph, sequential, or language-based systems, examining interpretability, personalization, and robustness in practical ranking tasks.

topics.name: Natural language processing and multilingual learning
topics.summary: Language research spans multilingual translation, low-resource modeling, document reasoning, simplification, and speech interfaces, using retrieval, adapters, and structured linguistic supervision.

topics.name: Generative models for structured data and biology
topics.summary: Generative modeling work reconstructs biological structure, scientific fields, and structured media from sparse observations, evaluating fidelity, controllability, and downstream scientific utility.

topics.name: Adversarial robustness and anomaly detection
topics.summary: Robustness studies probe adversarial perturbations, corrupted inputs, poisoning, and anomaly detection, comparing transferability, uncertainty, and defenses across vision and retrieval systems.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning and sequential decision making
topics.summary: Sequential-decision papers develop robust policies, reward shaping, world models, and multi-agent coordination, testing them in games, control, traffic, and long-horizon simulation.

topics.name: Theoretical machine learning and statistical methods
topics.summary: Theory papers establish guarantees for optimization, causal inference, statistical tests, and representation learning, connecting convergence or identifiability results to practical model diagnostics.

topics.name: Human-AI interaction and social computing
topics.summary: Human-centered studies measure trust, accessibility, social effects, and interaction quality in AI tools, combining user experiments with interfaces for education, medicine, and creative work.

topics.name: Information retrieval and search systems
topics.summary: Search research evaluates evidence retrieval, code and research agents, vector ranking, and multimodal queries, focusing on failure attribution, cost control, and trustworthy result synthesis.

topics.name: Hardware-aware and edge AI systems
topics.summary: Systems papers co-design algorithms and hardware for edge inference, compiler or kernel specialization, networked devices, and FPGA or accelerator deployment under tight resource budgets.

topics.name: Data-centric learning and benchmark construction
topics.summary: Dataset and benchmark papers introduce annotations, challenge protocols, and data-quality analyses for video, remote sensing, medicine, and multimodal learning, exposing gaps in generalization.

topics.name: Explainability, interpretability, and model analysis
topics.summary: Interpretability work studies internal representations, activation steering, causal attribution, and explanation reliability, linking model signals to human concepts and operational decisions.

topics.name: Optimization, control, and operations research
topics.summary: Optimization and control studies use constrained learning, expert routing, formal safety checks, and policy gradients for resource allocation, robotics, and multi-agent systems.

topics.name: Privacy, fairness, and responsible AI
topics.summary: Responsible-AI work examines auditability, demographic bias, and ethical governance, proposing measurement or design principles for privacy-preserving and socially accountable deployment.
